high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "live_mint," which appears to be a verified account. The post is titled "National highways and vehicles have grown at a brisk pace since 1991." It features a bar chart that compares two sets of data: the cumulative length of national highways (in kilometers) and the number of registered vehicles (in millions). X-axis: Represents different time periods from 1950-51 to 2020-21. Y-axis: Left side: Cumulative
